notes: Source: official AJA spec sheet PDF (aja.com/products/kumo-1616/spec-sheet.pdf), dated 07/3/2026, fetched directly and OCR'd. All 16 SDI inputs and 16 SDI outputs are individually labeled 1-16 on the rear panel but modeled as two grouped ports for brevity; connector is BNC, grade sdi-3g since the unit is rated for 270Mbps/1.5Gbps/3Gbps SDI (SD/HD/3G) per SMPTE-259/292/424 (this is the standard KUMO 1616, distinct from the KUMO 1616-12G variant which supports higher grades). Reference input is 2x BNC, looping/non-terminating, accepts blackburst or tri-level sync — left ungraded since it's a sync reference, not a payload SDI signal. Power: the chassis itself is powered via a dual-redundant 4-pin Molex DC connector (10-14VDC regulated, 13W typical/21.6W max); an external AC-to-DC adapter (100-240VAC, 50/60Hz, universal input, 60W) is included and plugs into that Molex DC input — modeled here as a single dc-barrel-style DC power input since "4-pin Molex DC" is not in the allowed connector list and dc-barrel/xlr4-dc are the closest analogues; xlr4-dc was chosen as the better match for a locking multi-pin DC connector. A second, optional redundant AC adapter (KUMO-PWR) can be added to the second Molex input. USB port is physically Mini-USB (not in the connector list); mapped to usb-b as the closest available family, no grade set since it's used only for IP configuration (not a data-transfer-graded link). RS-422 uses a DB-9 (D-sub) female connector; mapped to rs422 connector id directly. Rack size 1RU, desktop/rack convertible but shipped as 1RU rackmount.
